case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Thank you for working through the options with us. We value a reliable agreement. The alternative changes one commercial term in exchange for the quoted price reduction. Both changes are conditional on accepting the complete package. Which package can you authorize? Any movement is conditional on the executable terms below.

Executable packages:

Package 2: Unit price (EUR): 45.18; Payment (days): 30; Contract duration (months): 24; Effective date: "2026-12-01"
Package 3: Unit price (EUR): 34.43; Payment (days): 60; Contract duration (months): 12; Effective date: "2026-12-01"

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry has always deeply valued our long-standing relationship, and we warmly welcome the stability that a contract term of 24 months brings to our business. In exchange for this extended commitment, we are pleased to offer a significant price reduction. 

Your proposed prices are unfortunately not feasible given our cost structure, but we believe €51.30 per unit is a fair step forward. Therefore, our price of €51.30 per unit comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this tailored Angebot reflects both our appreciation for our history together and our commitment to serving you with pride.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
